title: The Rainbow Promise
lines: Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked out. The ground was dry at last.
God said: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and every living thing. And out they came, into a brand new world.
The first thing Noah did was build an altar, and give thanks to the Lord.
And God made a promise: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall not cease.
Never again would a flood destroy the earth. And God gave a sign, so they would never forget.
I do set my bow in the cloud. Every time the rain falls and the rainbow appears, God remembers His promise.
So the next time you see a rainbow, remember: God keeps His promises. Every single one.
Next time: the tower of Babel. Follow so you don't miss it!
